ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)
notes: DALI is a protocol specification, not a silicon part — there is no protocol-level OTP / fuse / configuration ROM. However, every control gear must persist a defined set of configuration variables in non-volatile storage so that they survive a bus power cycle. SLAA422A places these variables in the MSP430 information-memory flash (Table 2 of the report); on power-up TI_DALI_Init() copies them from flash into RAM, and TI_DALI_Flash_Update() — called once before VCC drops below 2.2 V (detected via Comparator_A+) — writes any modified RAM variables back. The 32-byte layout below mirrors Table 2 of SLAA422A exactly.

ti_information_memory_layout.name: Power On Level
ti_information_memory_layout.description: Arc power level applied within 600 ms of power-up if no DALI command is received.

ti_information_memory_layout.name: System Failure Level
ti_information_memory_layout.description: Arc power level applied when the bus voltage is lost for longer than the protected interval.

ti_information_memory_layout.name: Minimum Level
ti_information_memory_layout.description: Lower clamp for Actual Level; ≥ PHYS_MIN_LEVEL.

ti_information_memory_layout.name: Random Address (3 bytes)
ti_information_memory_layout.description: 24-bit Random Address used during the addressing iteration.

ti_information_memory_layout.name: Fast Fade Time
ti_information_memory_layout.description: Fast-fade-time selector for the device-type-specific fast fade ramp.

ti_information_memory_layout.name: Operating Mode
ti_information_memory_layout.description: Device-type-specific operating mode (e.g. PWM vs CCR for LED driver).

ti_information_memory_layout.name: Dimming Curve
ti_information_memory_layout.description: Selected dimming curve (logarithmic vs linear; vendor-defined).

flash_write_constraints.rationale_for_6_partition: Dividing the information memory space into six equal parts across three segments allows for six times the number of write/erase cycles.

ti_special_functions.name: TI_DALI_Init(FWKEY)
ti_special_functions.purpose: Configure DALI GPIOs, copy flash variables into RAM, initialize WDT+.

ti_special_functions.name: TI_DALI_Flash_Update(FWKEY)
ti_special_functions.purpose: Copy modified RAM variables back to information memory before power-down; called once when VCC is about to drop below 2.2 V.

ti_special_functions.name: flash_update_request
ti_special_functions.purpose: RAM flag that indicates one or more non-volatile variables have been modified since the last flash update.

unsupported_in_TI_app: Bank-1 memory map (would be used by IEC 62386-207 LED-specific extended parameters).
Commands 224..227 — Reference System Power, Enable/Disable Current Protector, Select Dimming Curve.
Queries 242..251 — LED-specific failure queries (Open, Short, Change in Load, Thermal Overload, Thermal Shutdown, Measurement fail, Current Protector Active/Enabled).
